_meta.rule: A game enters the feed once an official page prints a final score for it, or once the pinned dataset carries one. Rows from the dataset are marked official_type_dataset; rows transcribed from NFL.com are marked official_direct. Neither class is used as if it were the other.

reconciliation.verdict: Feed matches the official standings for every club.
